answer_1.quote: We formulate our task as producing a machine-generated character role label.
answer_1.outputs: character role labels consisting of a primary label and an optional modifier

answer_4.quote: We involve human participants at two levels. First, we rely on trained undergraduate research assistants to generate a reference set of character role labels... Second, we run a crowd-sourced ranked choice study to understand reader preferences for candidate role labels. Workers from Amazon Mechanical Turk (AMT) were shown the full article, a target character, and the candidate labels for that character from all LLMs and one randomly chosen human label.
answer_4.guideline: Workers were asked to rank them from best to worst and rate each label according to the criteria in Table 2. Faithfulness was rated on a binary "yes/no" scale following , while all other criteria used a 3-point Likert scale.
